name: Water and fluid pumps
summary: Pumps that move water and other liquids: submersible, centrifugal, diaphragm, bilge and hand pumps.
uses: Lifting water from wells, creeks and tanks
Pressurising a water system or shower
identify: 12V diaphragm pumps in RVs and boats; bilge pumps in boat hulls; sump pumps in basement pits; drain pumps in washers and dishwashers; pond and fountain pumps; well and pool pumps in sheds; hand pumps on farms and old wells.
test: Prime it and run it with the inlet in a bucket: water should flow steadily. Don’t run it dry for long, and power mains pumps near water only through an RCD (GFCI).

decay.note: Lasts; seals dry out and impellers stick after long storage but often free up.
